name: partial-graph-hybrid-selector6-native-check-overlay-002
qualification: Objective-C++ syntax-only and CPU fixture-layout checks passed. No full source build, CTest Metal execution, GPU run, shipping-topology admission, or peak-resident-memory measurement was performed.
scope: Extend the existing preconditioner GPU checker with selector-6 production-kernel tests and selector-5/6 Runtime acceptance comparison; increase the existing CTest timeout to 900 seconds. No solver/runtime/material changes.
limitations: Native Metal tests are prepared but not executed in this overlay.
The compiled native fixture is four FEM nodes and one tetrahedron; it is not the shipping mesh topology.
Device maxBufferLength and Runtime residentBytes are reported as limits/accounting only; peak memory is not measured.
RuntimeStateSnapshot does not expose FGMRES Arnoldi iteration counts; the test instead requires nonzero accepted relative correction and representable loaded-node motion.
Acceptance parity means both selector runs accept the same authored physical fixture; selector-to-selector state deltas are reported without a calibrated error threshold.
